scenario.summary: UAT-6275 is conducting an espionage campaign against government and critical infrastructure in the CIS region using custom reverse shells. The group utilizes diverse initial access vectors including phishing with macro-enabled documents, WinRAR exploits, and the exploitation of vulnerabilities in Ivanti and SonicWall appliances, maintaining persistence through scheduled tasks and the Windows Startup folder.

meta.rationale: Focus on internet-facing Windows servers and infrastructure in the CIS region first. Expand to workstations if the GitHub-hosted scripts are detected on any beachhead host.
meta.hypothesis: An espionage actor has established a beachhead via edge appliance exploitation or archive delivery, established persistence through scheduled tasks, and is maintaining access via a PowerShell-based reverse shell.

hunt.name: Regional Government and Infrastructure Espionage Activity
hunt.description: This hunt follows the tradecraft of UAT-6275, an actor targeting government and critical infrastructure for diplomatic and economic intelligence. The hunt identifies vulnerable edge appliances such as Ivanti or SonicWall, then parallels searches for malicious file drops and GitHub-hosted script execution. Following an initial triage, it shifts to finding follow-on persistence in the task scheduler and outbound reverse-shell traffic, correlating these disparate stages into a high-confidence intrusion verdict.

config.rationale: An espionage actor has established a beachhead via edge appliance exploitation or archive delivery, established persistence through scheduled tasks, and is maintaining access via a PowerShell-based reverse shell.

config.content: SELECT device_uid, cve_uid, title, severity, first_seen FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE (cve_uid = 'CVE-2026-104935' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%ivanti%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%sonicwall%')
config.description: Scope the hunt to hosts where the environment has found appliance-based vulnerabilities like the Ivanti bypass or SonicWall SSRF.
config.expected_signal: A list of device UIDs affected by edge appliance vulnerabilities. Silence means no appliances in scope are flagged as vulnerable to these specific CVEs.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_hash_sha256, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{uat_hashes}}' || ',', ',' || file_hash_sha256 || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%\\winrar.exe') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Search for specific hashes and rare files dropped by suspicious parent processes like WinRAR.
config.expected_signal: Any row showing known malicious hashes or files dropped by archive utilities. Silence means no suspicious drops were observed.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, script_content, script_type, time FROM hb_script_activity WHERE (LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%github%' AND (LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%iex%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%invoke-expression%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%downloadstring%')) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify PowerShell execution that pulls payloads from GitHub, a common UAT-6275 delivery method.

config.content: SELECT job_name, job_cmd_line, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_scheduled_job WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY job_cmd_line HAVING hosts <= 2
config.description: Stack-count scheduled jobs to find rare persistence entries created by the actor.
config.expected_signal: Scheduled tasks with rare command lines that appear on only one or two hosts. Silence means no rare tasks were identified.
